context: A ~25 minute follow-up sales call with Acme, three weeks after their 2-week pilot of 'Raven' (a meeting-memory product). Marco and Dana from Raven; Lena and Raj from Acme. This call reviews the pilot and negotiates the full rollout. Decisions here SUPERSEDE the earlier discovery call: terms have changed.

participants.name: Marco
participants.role: account executive at Raven, runs the call

participants.name: Lena
participants.role: VP of Engineering at Acme, the prospect

mustInclude: The 2-week pilot went well and Acme's engineers adopted Raven quickly.
Lena says the 'ask across meetings' feature already saved her team time tracking decisions.
Decision: Acme will expand from the 10-seat pilot to 25 seats for the full rollout.
Budget update: Lena confirms the budget is now about forty-five thousand dollars a year for the larger rollout, up from the earlier figure.
Raj confirms procurement has now approved the spend for this fiscal year.
Decision: Acme agrees to sign a 12-month annual contract starting in August.
The SOC 2 Type II report was delivered and Acme's security team reviewed and accepted it.
New blocker: before full rollout Acme needs SSO via SAML integrated with their Okta, otherwise IT won't approve company-wide access.
Action item: Marco will send the annual contract for signature by Thursday.
Action item: Dana will schedule the SSO/SAML integration kickoff for next week.
Action item: Lena will introduce Marco to Acme's IT lead for the Okta setup.
Everyone agrees the goal is to have the 25-seat rollout live by the end of August.
